incident.failure: A healthy resource-dominating control cell exceeded the file-progress stale window. The controller killed it, then inherited the stale timestamp on every retry while launchd kept restarting the exhausted controller.

repair.process_group_activity: Exact process-group CPU time, resident memory, member count, and states are sampled by the lifecycle controller and signed into its heartbeat.
repair.attempt_local_grace: Every attempt starts with its own progress origin; status from a prior attempt cannot immediately stale-kill a fresh child.
repair.split_identity: The immutable scientific source and lifecycle controller program have separate paths and SHA-256 identities, allowing a controller-only recovery without rewriting cell fingerprints.
repair.stale_policy: The stale threshold remains a wedge detector. It is not a task deadline and does not terminate work while measured compute continues.
